purpose: Determine whether the retained scenario-bound run 009 supports a bounded command-to-motion and geometric diagnosis during its declared observation window without inventing a terminal result.

analysis_contract.observation_boundary: accepted goal wall timestamp plus the 100.0-second action_duration_s declared in the robot-visible runtime manifest
required_boundary_checks: exactly one accepted NavigateToPose goal exists
no NavigateToPose result exists before the declared boundary
capture_stopped exists at or after the declared boundary
only records at or before the declared boundary enter the computation
analysis_contract.action_status: remained active at the observation cutoff

implementation_gate: nonterminal analysis requires an explicit CLI flag
missing or invalid robot-visible cutoff metadata fails closed
tests cover opt-in, default rejection, premature capture stop, and records after cutoff

robot_visible: delivered commands and independently delivered odometry
goal-scoped behavior-tree transitions through the cutoff
delivered plans and costmap observations through the retained fixture projection
exact runtime source/configuration hashes and declared action duration
withheld: scenario expected outcome and evaluator geometry
a unique actuator, collision, obstruction, or slip cause
a terminal outcome that was not observed

next_gate: Only if the bounded exports and independent references agree may a separate prospective declaration consider this inspected case for development-only composition-plan testing; terminal-failure language remains prohibited.
